view.text:
env:
  P453_MARK: ${secret:gh-token}
mcp_servers:
  gh:
    url: http://127.0.0.1:9/mcp
    headers:
      Authorization: Bearer ${secret:gh-token}
hooks:
  mark:
    event: session_start
    command: echo mark
claude:
  status_line:
    command: echo user-status
  skip_hooks: []
